g.text: LIS2DW12: 0x19; INT1 for motion event wake.

g.desc: LIS2DW12: 0x19; INT1 for motion event wake.

g.text: CS and SA0 high. Reserved pad 7 is grounded.

g.desc: CS and SA0 high. Reserved pad 7 is grounded.

g.text: IR RX shares ACC_EN. Quiesce I/O before disabling.

g.desc: IR RX shares ACC_EN. Quiesce I/O before disabling.

g.text: Tune the PCB loop in the finished badge; tuning caps DNP.

g.desc: Tune the PCB loop in the finished badge; tuning caps DNP.

g.text: NTAG: 0x55. Center metal is NOT soldered.

g.desc: NTAG: 0x55. Center metal is NOT soldered.

g.text: Qwiic + SAO: 3.3 V only, 50 mA shared budget.

g.desc: Qwiic + SAO: 3.3 V only, 50 mA shared budget.

g.text: 50 mA normal total. 210k / 1% sets 109-152.3 mA current limit.

g.desc: 50 mA normal total. 210k / 1% sets 109-152.3 mA current limit.

g.text: No hot-plug, external power or off-state GPIO drive.

g.desc: No hot-plug, external power or off-state GPIO drive.

g.text: BH1730: 0x29; poll ambient light. INT unused.

g.desc: BH1730: 0x29; poll ambient light. INT unused.

g.text: ONBOARD I2C: 100 kHz initially. NTAG errata: STOP/START >= 50 us; guard RF edges; quiet bus for 1 ms at startup.

g.desc: ONBOARD I2C: 100 kHz initially. NTAG errata: STOP/START >= 50 us; guard RF edges; quiet bus for 1 ms at startup.
